email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Ryan, saw dbt Labs closed the Fivetran merger and was named Snowflake's 2026 Data Integration Partner of the Year.

After a merger like that, majors sales usually has far more in-market accounts than the team can cover while the motions combine, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ryan, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

Post-merger, the combined majors list jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your majors team needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ryan, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs's reply rate likely compares to other data-platform teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ryan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling majors pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a merger, timing is everything, and the integration stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a majors data motion? I will tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
